title: Support Engineer
description:
**Aarya ITES Pvt Ltd**, a leading IT, Network, Safety, Security \& Automation solution provider company, is looking for a reliable and technically sound **Support Technical Engineer** to manage day\-to\-day technical support activities. The successful applicant will have good communication skills, a customer\-oriented approach, and the ability to coordinate effectively with clients and field engineers. We’re looking for someone who can work independently, handle multiple service requests efficiently, and ensure timely resolution of customer issues.

**Job Title:** Support Technical Engineer

**Experience:** 1–3 Years in Technical Support / Customer Support / Service Coordination (ERP knowledge will be an added advantage)

**Employment Type:** Full Time (6 Days a week)

**Location:** Bodakdev, Ahmedabad

**Support Technical Engineer responsibilities and duties**

* Attend customer calls and provide first\-level technical support.
* Register service complaints and maintain proper service records.
* Coordinate and assign service calls to field engineers.
* Follow up on pending service calls and ongoing projects.
* Provide remote software support, installation, and user guidance.
* Prepare AMC quotations and coordinate AMC renewals.
* Follow up for AMC approvals and payment collections.
* Ensure Preventive Maintenance Calls (PMC) are completed on schedule.
* Verify engineers' service reports and expense claims.
* Maintain technical support data and documentation in ERP.
* Coordinate the purchase of accessories and materials required by service engineers.
* Prepare and maintain reports related to the technical support department.

**Qualifications \& Requirements:**

* Diploma/Bachelor’s Degree in EC, IT, Computer, Electronics Engineering, or related field.
* Good knowledge of computer hardware, networking, and software installation.
* Proficiency in MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook).
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Good coordination, documentation, and customer handling skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and work under pressure.
* Positive attitude, problem\-solving skills, and willingness to learn.

**Forward your CV to:** hr@a\-ites.com

**WhatsApp:** \+91 92271 95202

Pay: ₹16,000\.00 \- ₹22,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: CCTV Engineer
description:
Job description:

Nakoda Infotek is looking for an experienced **CCTV Engineer** to join our technical team in Ahmedabad.

The candidate will be responsible for installation, configuration, commissioning and troubleshooting of **CCTV Surveillance, Networking, Access Control and Security Systems** at customer locations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Configure and troubleshoot **NVR, DVR, IP \& PTZ cameras**
* Installation and configuration of **Access Control \& Biometric Systems**
* CCTV camera commissioning, testing and maintenance
* Configure **PoE switches and basic network infrastructure**
* Troubleshoot **TCP/IP, LAN, WAN and networking\-related issues**
* Perform onsite testing, commissioning and customer support
* Visit customer sites for installation and troubleshooting
* Prepare basic installation/service reports
* Coordinate with the project and sales team for technical requirements

**Required Skills**

* Good knowledge of **CCTV Surveillance Systems**
* Experience with brands such as **Hikvision, CP Plus, Uniview/UNV, Dahua** or similar
* Good understanding of **NVR/DVR configuration**

* Basic knowledge of **TCP/IP, LAN, WAN and networking**
* Experience with **Access Control \& Biometric Systems**
* Good troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to work independently at customer locations
* Willingness to travel within **Ahmedabad \& Gujarat**

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Internet reimbursement
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time

title: BIT Support Engineer
description:
**Job Title: BIT Support Engineer** 

**Location: Ahmedabad**

**Experience: 5–10 Years**

**Employment Type: Full\-Time** 

Role Overview

We are looking for a skilled BIT Support Engineer (L2/L3\) to manage and support our enterprise IT infrastructure, networks, and cloud environments. The role involves handling critical incidents, ensuring high system availability, and acting as an escalation point for complex technical issues in a 24x7 operational setup.

Key Responsibilities

* Monitor and manage IT infrastructure using 24x7 monitoring tools
* Act as L2/L3 escalation point for complex incidents (P1/P2\) and perform root cause analysis (RCA)
* Administer and support Windows/Linux servers and enterprise applications
* Configure and manage network devices (routers, switches, firewalls, VPNs)
* Manage Next\-Generation Firewalls (NGFW) including policies, failover, and performance tuning
* Support data center operations including servers, SAN storage, and virtualization platforms
* Administer VMware/ESXi environments (VM provisioning, snapshots, cluster health)
* Manage and support cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Handle Microsoft 365 ecosystem (Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Azure AD, MFA)
* Ensure infrastructure security using antivirus, EDR tools, and security best practices
* Lead or support IT infrastructure projects (migrations, upgrades, deployments)
* Maintain SOPs, documentation, DR plans, and knowledge base
* Coordinate with vendors/TAMs for issue resolution and hardware/software support
* Mentor and guide junior engineers and improve team performance
* Ensure compliance with IT security standards and regulatory requirements

Required Skills \& Expertise

Technical Skills

* Strong experience in L2/L3 Support \& Incident Management (ITIL framework)
* Hands\-on experience with:
* Windows Server \& Linux (RHEL/Ubuntu)
* Networking (LAN/WAN, VPN, Routers, Switches)
* Firewalls (NGFW – Palo Alto, Fortinet, etc.)
* Virtualization (VMware/ESXi)
* Cloud Platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP)
* Microsoft 365 (Exchange, SharePoint, Azure AD)
* Knowledge of SAN Storage \& Data Center operations
* Familiarity with security tools (EDR, Antivirus) and compliance standards (ISO, PCI, GDPR)

Educational Qualification

* Bachelor’s Degree / Diploma in IT, Electronics, or related field
* Relevant certifications preferred:
* CCNA / CCNP
* Microsoft Certified
* AWS / Azure / Cloud certifications

Soft Skills

* Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities
* Ability to handle high\-pressure situations (critical outages)
* Good communication \& stakeholder management skills
* Ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines
* Team player with mentoring capabilities

**Note that the candidate would be required to work in rotational shift(morning, night and general).**

Work Location: In person
